Hi all,

Quick technical note from the processor: when a folio is created in a different currency than the card, the gateway posts the merchant descriptor and MCC based on the original folio details. If the merchant reissues an invoice in USD the gateway will typically re-route the settlement and the MCC can update to Lodging. We recommend trying merchant credit first; disputes are the fallback.

If you'd like, we can also provide a soft reversal on the virtual card and re-authorize a USD charge. That requires coordination for any incidental deposits/incidentals.

— Card Ops Team
